title: File Upload with Metadata
description: Upload files and return metadata (name, size, type), list all uploaded files, and retrieve metadata by file ID.

steps.title: Upload with metadata response
steps.description: Implement POST /upload that accepts a file and returns 200 with an object containing the file name, size, and type.
hints: Return JSON with name, size, type fields

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File
from datetime import datetime
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
file_meta = {}
file_id = 1
@app.post('/upload')
async def upload(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    global file_id
    content = await file.read()
    meta = {'id': file_id, 'name': file.filename, 'size': len(content), 'type': file.content_type, 'uploadedAt': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}
    file_meta[file_id] = meta
    file_id += 1
    return meta
